report_identity.report_title: TAKBO GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: The Group designs, develops, manufactures and sells beauty products and designs, develops and sells beauty bags.

segments.name: Design, development, manufacture and sale of beauty products
Design, development and sale of beauty bags

business_overview.revenue_model: Product revenue is recognised when control of beauty products or bags is transferred to customers; customer credit terms generally range from 30 to 120 days.
business_notes: Revenue fell 13.3% in 2024 and gross margin fell to 31.8%; management attributed the decline partly to US customers shifting purchases away from China and partial diversification to the UK market.
Revenue by geography in 2024 was mainly UK HK$84.308m, USA HK$57.701m, PRC HK$18.586m and other export markets.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year accounting profit converts unevenly: 2022 operating cash flow was inflated by receivable collection, 2023 was strong, and 2024 operating cash flow was close to net profit but below capital expenditure. Excess cash interest is material relative to profit and should be excluded when valuing the operating business.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2024 Management Discussion and Analysis, p.7

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company versus operating subsidiaries, so detachable cash haircuts use currency and PRC location as proxies.
No explicit restricted cash line was found; absence is treated as a disclosure fact, not proof that every group cash balance can be immediately distributed.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; median recent purchase of property, plant and equipment is used as a conservative maintenance-capex proxy.
